# OpenAgent

> AI content, images and videos, social media management, and Meta Ads & Google Ads for U.S. businesses. Run by Abeer Nasir.

OpenAgent helps U.S. brands, e-commerce businesses, B2B companies and small businesses produce human-reviewed AI-assisted content, publish consistently on social media, and run paid campaigns against one clear objective. Work is scoped in writing before it starts.
